name: kodar
description: Reports what this Claude Code session is working on to your kodar hub, so one dashboard shows every session across machines and accounts.

hub_url.title: Hub URL
hub_url.description: Where your kodar hub runs, such as https://kodar.example.com. Leave empty to keep this machine from reporting.

token.title: Ingest token
token.description: A token your kodar hub takes, such as one its bootstrap link made.

device.title: Device name
device.description: How this machine is labelled on the dashboard. Empty uses its hostname. The KODAR_DEVICE_NAME environment variable, where set, wins over this.

account.title: Account label
account.description: Which Claude account this is, such as personal or work. Empty uses the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR folder name, or default. A login listed in Accounts wins over this.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Labels for your Claude logins, as email=label pairs split by commas, such as you@home.example=personal, you@work.example=work. A session then reports its login's label and follows a /login to another one. The email is only compared here; just the label is sent. Empty skips the lookup.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: How much text leaves this machine: summary sends the first 160 characters of prompts, answers and tool targets; full sends up to 2000; minimal sends only project, branch, state and tool names.
